name: Jaguar CX-75
description: The Jaguar C-X75 is a plug-in hybrid supercar concept unveiled at the 2010 Paris Motor Show to celebrate Jaguar's 75th anniversary. Originally conceived with revolutionary diesel-powered micro gas turbines charging batteries for four YASA electric motors, the production version was redesigned with a more conventional hybrid powertrain. The production prototype features a 1.6-liter turbocharged and supercharged four-cylinder engine producing 502 hp, combined with two electric motors adding 390 hp for a combined system output of 892 hp and 1,000 Nm of torque. Developed in partnership with the Williams F1 Team, the C-X75 was capable of 0-100 km/h in under 3 seconds and a top speed of 354 km/h. The project was ultimately cancelled in 2012, with only five prototypes built. The C-X75 gained worldwide fame after appearing as the villain's car in the 2015 James Bond film Spectre, showcasing its dramatic styling and performance in a memorable chase through Rome.
author: DanielDi
